title: Rockstar Games Union Vote Set for GTA6 Release Window
description: A date has been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on a developer union, taking place over the GTA6 release window.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Games Union Vote Set for GTA6 Release Window

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, a definitive date has now been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on whether to formally recognise their developer union. Notably, this crucial vote is scheduled to take place right over the release window of Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA6).

## Potential to Become the UK Industry's Largest Recognised Union

Labour rights and workplace conditions within the video games industry have consistently been hot topics for both developers and the gaming community. This upcoming vote by Rockstar staff marks a significant development in that ongoing conversation. If the vote is successful, the resulting organisation will officially become the largest recognised union across the entirety of the UK video games industry.

As the gaming world keeps a close eye on Rockstar Games ahead of the launch of GTA6, internal developments such as this union vote highlight the evolving landscape of game development culture and corporate governance.

## Editor's Take

As an editor at GTA6 Hub, seeing this union vote land directly within the GTA6 release window brings a fascinating dynamic to one of gaming's biggest launches. Balancing the intense pressures of AAA game development with worker representation is a critical step forward for the industry, and the outcome of this vote could set an important precedent for UK game developers moving ahead.
